evidence.title: Aqua — the classic Apple UI, as a shadcn registry
Aqua — full component reference for LLMs

name: Aqua
summary: shadcn registry that recreates the classic Mac OS X interface as glossy React components.
description: Aqua is a shadcn/ui registry (@aqua) of 26 glossy, skeuomorphic components in the Mac OS X 2000–2007 visual language: gel buttons, pinstripe panes, brushed metal, the Dock and a working iPod. Components are built on Radix primitives and Tailwind CSS and copied into your project as open code; install with npx shadcn add @aqua and retheme everything through the --aqua-accent CSS variable.
contains: 26 registry items under the @aqua namespace, installed with the shadcn CLI
Mac OS X era look: gel buttons, pinstripes, brushed metal, Aqua cursors
Built on Radix primitives + Tailwind CSS; keyboard and ARIA behavior included
Themed by the --aqua-accent CSS variable, with a shared @aqua/theme palette and Lucida Grande typography
Demos: Mail, Finder, iTunes, Chat and a working iPod click wheel
llms.txt and llms-full.txt references for agents
